articles.title: Tether's U.S.-focused stablecoin grows over 500% in a month, but still lags main rivals
articles.snippet: USAT's market cap jumped above $140 million in April, though it remains well behind Circle's USDC, PayPal's PYUSD and Ripple's RLUSD tokens.

articles.title: 'Debasement trade’ falls out of favor as inflation fears cool, JPMorgan says
articles.snippet: Investors are abandoning bitcoin and gold, perhaps sensing a coming end to Middle East hostilities.

articles.title: Polymarket exec says KYC limited to beta product, not existing platform
articles.snippet: Polymarket executive Josh Stevens said identity checks apply only to early beta access and are not being added to Polymarket’s existing platform.

articles.title: Crypto liquidations hit $935M as Bitcoin price dips to $72.6K
articles.snippet: Over $935 million was wiped out across the crypto market as traders shifted their focus to $70,000 as the last line of defense for Bitcoin.

articles.title: Bitcoin Slips Under $73K as Crypto Liquidations Near $1B
articles.snippet: The near-$1 billion crypto liquidation spree comes amid rising tensions over the U.S.-Iran conflict and ETF outflows.
